Processing Time

All orders are processed within 1–2 business days (Monday–Friday). Orders placed on weekends or public holidays will be processed on the next working day.

Shipping Rates & Delivery Times

  • UK Standard Delivery: 3–5 business days — Free for orders over £40, otherwise £3.99
  • UK Express Delivery: 1–2 business days — £6.99.
  • International Delivery: 7–14 business days — Shipping cost calculated at checkout.
    Please note: Delivery times may vary depending on customs clearance and local postal services.

Order Tracking

Once your order has been dispatched, you will receive an email with tracking details. You can track your order directly via our courier’s website.

Customs, Duties & Taxes

International customers are responsible for any customs fees, import duties, or taxes applied by their destination country.

Damaged or Missing Items

If your order arrives damaged or incomplete, please contact us within 48 hours of delivery at support@beeblend.co.uk with your order number and photos of the items. We’ll resolve it promptly.
